en: A black‑and‑white interior scene showing a woman standing behind a tall wooden reception or office desk. She wears an early‑20th‑century style blouse with a ruffled front and looks toward the camera. On the counter and behind her are office items such as books, papers, a desk lamp, and an early box‑style telephone. The room has dark wood paneling and frosted glass partitions, suggesting a bank, hotel, or administrative office.
